protocol.scope: TRAIN-only exploratory development; no validation, REPORT, TEST or FPV labels read
protocol.assignment: Sort entities by SHA256(seed:cluster_id), then round-robin modulo 3; same ordering rule inside outer fit
protocol.pair_rule: Both endpoints in a part; all crossing pairs excluded and counted
protocol.fit_rule: Fresh TF-IDF, train_informativeness and LR inside every inner fit; refit on outer fit after selection
protocol.selection: Pooled inner OOF F1, then precision, higher threshold, then grid order (smaller C first)
protocol.adaptive_version: Existing grouped Adaptive v1, unchanged; prior=0.20, penalty=0

logistic.missing_encoding: zero similarity + availability=0, observed zero + availability=1

protocol.hard_negatives: Official is_hard_negative=True among label=0; report FPR/counts, not negative-only F1

missingness.unit: One SHA256(seed:raw_field:offer_id) mask per offer/raw field, stable across pairs and methods
missingness.training: Clean training only; no masked refits
missingness.thresholds: Each selected outer threshold remains unchanged across all rates/seeds/scenarios

protocol.aggregation: Primary pooled outer confusion matrix; fold metrics secondary. Three mask seeds are not independent datasets.
